{"id":1890552427,"question_id":3605,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768880865,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"2 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1890552427/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array I","memory":"25 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> minBitwiseArray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans(n , -1);\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<nums[i] ; j++)\n            {\n                int binary = j | (j+1);\n                if(binary == nums[i])\n                {\n                    ans[i] = j;\n                    break;\n                } \n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1522}
